newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - WHX Corp raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - WHX Corp raised.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Monday it raised its rating on the shares of WHX Corp to a buy from hold, after its Wheeling-Pittsburgh Corp unit and the United Steelworkers of America reached a tentative deal on a new contract to settle a 10-month strike.

-- "The company seems to have satisfied worker demands for a defined benefit pension plans without costing itself a lot of money," said analyst Aldo Mazzaferro. "In return, it seems to have gotten some nice productivity benefits."
-- Mazzaferro said his 12-month target for the stock was $15 to $16 per share.
